note: Capability registry: actions are DATA, not code. The encoder's action head is derived from these descriptions, so adding a capability means appending an entry and re-encoding it — no retraining, no new class id.

capabilities.description: Look up game knowledge (monsters, spells, quests, items, NPCs, achievements, dungeons) in the local DofusDB cache. Use before claiming any game fact.
capabilities.returns: list of compact records with 'id', 'name' (localised dict) and key fields

query.doc: Free-text name or keyword, any of the 4 languages.

capabilities.description: Travel to a target. Give one of: [x,y] coordinates, a zaap name, an NPC, a map id, a cell, or a direction. `direction` leaves by that edge; `cell` walks to that specific spot on the current map.
capabilities.returns: transition ack; for an adjacent map the client walks to the border cell first, and a non-adjacent target is refused with the current map's exits

npc_id.doc: NPC id on the current map, as listed in snapshot.map.npcs.

cell.doc: Walk to this cell on the current map (a specific spot).

direction.doc: Leave by this edge of the current map.

capabilities.description: Follow a character on the current map and through map changes. Empty name means 'follow the order giver'.

name.doc: Character name to follow; empty = the order giver.

capabilities.description: List quests suitable for a level (and optionally an area), with start position and step objectives.
capabilities.returns: list of quests with id, localised name, level range and step objectives

area.doc: Area or subarea name filter, any language (e.g. 'astrub').

capabilities.description: Execute the next actionable step of a quest: navigate, talk to the NPC, harvest, or fight as the step objective requires.

npc_id.doc: Talk to this NPC, by the template id the objective carries.

objective_id.doc: Validate this objective. Use it to claim one the game already accepts (objectiveStatus 2).

reply.doc: Which dialog reply to choose, by index. Defaults to 0, which is what an unanswered NPC dialog needs.

reply_text.doc: Which dialog reply to choose, by the exact French text reported in dialog.replies. With reply, both must agree.

capabilities.description: Start a farm loop: kill monster groups and/or harvest resources, looting according to the filter, optionally auto-selling.
capabilities.returns: farm session id and live counters

monster.doc: Monster id from the objective, or a name from the corpus. The client needs an id; the harness resolves a name.

resource.doc: Resource id from the objective, or a name. The client harvests the nearest interactive element; the id selects it when the client can.

zone.doc: Area/subarea to stay inside, any language.

loot_filter.doc: Item names to keep; others can be dropped.

auto_sell.doc: Auto-list kept loot on the market when bags fill.

capabilities.description: Stop the active farm loop and return to a safe idle state.
Join a fight: a monster group containing the named monster, an explicit group, or the nearest group.

monster.doc: Monster id from the objective. The group containing it is chosen; the client knows which group that is.

group_id.doc: Explicit monster-group id, when the caller already has one.

capabilities.description: Pass the current combat turn.
List inventory contents, optionally filtered by kind.
capabilities.returns: items with id, name, quantity, unit weight

capabilities.description: Sell inventory items on the market (HDV) at a price rule. Default rule is median market price minus 1 kama.
capabilities.returns: per-item listing report (price used, quantity, market depth)

quantity.doc: Units to sell. Default 1: a bare "sell X" sells one unit, never the whole stack.

min_stock.doc: Keep at least this many units.

capabilities.description: Scan the market (HDV) for an item and return price statistics (min/median/max over current listings).

category.doc: Market category id, when browsing rather than searching.

capabilities.description: List an item for sale on the market at an explicit or rule-based price.
Send a chat message.
Request a structured snapshot of current game state (position, map, HP, inventory summary, active fight).
capabilities.returns: observation dict recorded into the trajectory log

capabilities.description: Emergency stop: halt farm/fight loops, stop acting, log out of dangerous situations. Always available.

Record something you discovered that the cache does not know (an NPC's map, a drop, a price, a quest prerequisite). Facts keep their provenance, so a wrong one can be corrected or forgotten. Never use this to copy the cache.

value.doc: The fact as text or JSON, e.g. '12345' or '{"map": 123}'.

confidence.doc: 0-1; 0.9 if you saw it, 0.5 if inferred.

capabilities.description: Delete a fact that turned out to be wrong. Use it instead of storing a contradicting value, so the store stays small.

key.doc: Key of the fact to remove.

reason.doc: Why it is wrong (kept in the log).

capabilities.description: Read the live combat board: turn owner, fighters, cells, HP/AP/MP, team membership, and the controlled character's spell descriptors. The result also carries a versioned observation and a contract naming any fact the client did not expose.
capabilities.returns: turn, fighter and spell facts from the live client, plus observation/contract

capabilities.description: Read the live board and compute this turn's legal move-and-cast plan: exact cell geometry, line of sight, AP/MP, cooldowns, resistances, damage and healing. top_k > 1 also returns alternative plans (including pass) for a ranker. Read-only; it never casts or moves anything. Every answer carries the live observation and its contract.
capabilities.returns: actions with cells/targets/AP/MP/damage, plus the normalized live observation, its contract, and the ranker decision

beam_width.doc: How many partial turns to keep while searching.

max_actions.doc: Maximum casts to consider in the plan.

top_k.doc: Also return this many candidate plans; 1 = best only.

rank_with_value.doc: Compatibility alias for ranker=value: rank candidates with the learned encounter value head.

ranker.doc: Which plan ranker to use. 'solver' keeps the solver order; 'value' ranks candidates with the learned value head and refuses when the live observation lacks self stats or enemy spell facts.

capabilities.description: Estimate whether the controlled character can win a monster group visible on this map: turns to kill, incoming damage, expected HP loss, and a calibrated win probability. Read-only; it never joins or casts.
capabilities.returns: p_win (null until calibrated), raw_score, expected_hp_loss and turns, confidence, missing inputs, allowed and blocked_reason

monster.doc: Monster id or name. When several visible groups contain it, the least favourable one is estimated.
